title: Object Storage: cool review — included quantity limit
content:
For Object Storage cool review, use the smaller of completed entitlement quantity and the current shared capacity ceiling as the included inclusion.

## Basis Q&A

What determines cool review in this situation? Use the smaller of completed entitlement quantity and the current shared capacity ceiling as the included inclusion.

## Hypothetical cool review — included quantity limit case

For this cool review — included quantity limit example, assume hypothetical completed entitlement of 140 GB-month and current shared capacity ceiling of 90 GB-month. The included inclusion is 90 GB-month. Reversing those two input amounts still gives 90 GB-month.
